name: Agatsuma Kanae
source:
A beautiful wife neighbor. Always greets the protagonist affably. She seems to be pregnant. 
Her husband is a busy man and seems to work overseas as he is nowhere to be seen.

"Mitsuru-kun, can I rely on you in the future?"
